# Learn Prompting Weekly Newsletter

> > Weekly insights on prompt engineering, generative AI breakthroughs, and practical tutorials covering the latest from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and the AI frontier.

Learn Prompting's Newsletter delivers weekly coverage of major AI model releases (GPT-5, Gemini, Claude), practical tutorials on prompt engineering and AI tools, and analysis of emerging trends in generative AI, image generation, and AI security. The newsletter serves both beginners and advanced practitioners exploring ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other cutting-edge AI systems.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- Generative AI
- OpenAI GPT-5
- Google Gemini
- Anthropic Claude
- AI Image Generation
- ChatGPT
- Gemini 2.5 Pro
- AI Image Editing
- Conversational AI
- AI Security & Jailbreaking
- Prompt Hacking
- No-Code AI Tools
- AI Tutoring
- Model Comparison
